what_it_is: Difference between BOC's USD selling rate and the buy/sell midpoint — the price of converting, not a tax or fee.
applies_when: Every onshore RMB→USD purchase (F01, F02, F04–F07, F09, F11).

what_it_is: BOC personal cross-border wire: 1‰ of the amount plus cable fee.
amount_or_rate_blank_if_empty: 1‰, min CNY 50, max CNY 260, + CNY 150 cable (non-HK/Macau/Taiwan)
applies_when: Each wire (F01–F07, F09). Repeats per year on F07.

what_it_is: Deductions by correspondent banks in the chain and the U.S. bank's incoming-wire fee.
applies_when: Most international wires; size depends on the chain and the OUR/SHA/BEN choice.

layer: 4. Chinese tax on the underlying income
what_it_is: IIT that was always owed on the income that created the RMB — collected before or at conversion via the tax-evidence requirement. Not a conversion tax.
amount_or_rate_blank_if_empty: Wages/comprehensive 3%–45%; dividends, rent, property gain, incidental 20%; business 5%–35% (on the gain/base defined by law)
applies_when: Only if the tax is still unpaid. Zero additional amount if withholding/certificates already cover it (Q07).

what_it_is: U.S. tax on the exchange gain when RMB is sold for USD. Gain illustrated on the Costs page; the tax itself needs your marginal rate (Q15). Character (ordinary per §988(a) vs 'capital' per Pub. 525) conflicts in official sources — flagged.
applies_when: Conversions where the RMB appreciated since acquisition, unless the personal-transaction gain is USD 200 or less.

what_it_is: U.S. reporting penalty — applies to the account's history, not to the wire. Filing is free; the penalty is for not filing.
amount_or_rate_blank_if_empty: Non-willful: up to USD 16,536. Willful: USD 165,353 or 50% of the account balance (statutory greater-of, inflation-adjusted floor).
applies_when: Foreign accounts over USD 10,000 aggregate in any year, unfiled.

what_it_is: U.S. reporting penalty for specified foreign financial assets above the higher thresholds.
amount_or_rate_blank_if_empty: USD 10,000, + USD 10,000 per 30 days after IRS notice, max USD 60,000 (criminal penalties may also apply).
applies_when: Above USD 50k/75k (in U.S.) or USD 200k/300k (abroad), unmarried; double for joint filers.

what_it_is: U.S. reporting penalty for large foreign gifts/bequests.
amount_or_rate_blank_if_empty: 5% of the gift per month late, max 25%; IRS may also determine the tax consequences of the gift.
applies_when: Gifts/bequests over USD 100,000 from a foreign individual/estate in a tax year, unreported.

layer: 7a. China: splitting / private FX / false documents
what_it_is: Enforcement fines for the prohibited rows X01–X03 — the real 'penalty' in this problem.
amount_or_rate_blank_if_empty: Up to 30% of the amount; 30%–100% in serious cases; confiscation of gains (private trading); untrue documents up to CNY 50,000; criminal liability possible; watch list for the year + 2 years (splitting).
applies_when: Any use of X01–X03 at any amount.

what_it_is: Fine for carrying FX across the border in breach of the permit rules (X04).
amount_or_rate_blank_if_empty: Warning; fine up to 20% of the amount.
applies_when: Carrying over the permitted amount without the required permit.

what_it_is: Calendar years consumed by F07 (8), F10 (27) and F11 (80 trips) at USD 400,000. Not a fee — the reason capped routes fail large balances.
amount_or_rate_blank_if_empty: See the time/units columns on the Costs page (computed from the official caps).
applies_when: Any balance above one year's/one trip's cap on those routes.
